verses.english: “Reverend, they speak of this thing called the ‘spiritual path’.

verses.pali: Katamaṁ nu kho, āvuso, brahmacariyaṁ, katamaṁ brahmacariyapariyosānan”ti?
verses.english: What is the spiritual path? And what is the culmination of the spiritual path?”

verses.pali: Bhaddako kho te, āvuso bhadda, ummaṅgo, bhaddakaṁ paṭibhānaṁ, kalyāṇī paripucchā.
verses.english: Your approach and eloquence are excellent, and it’s a good question.
‘They speak of this thing called “the spiritual path”.

verses.pali: Katamaṁ nu kho, āvuso, brahmacariyaṁ, katamaṁ brahmacariyapariyosānan’”ti?
verses.english: What is the spiritual path? And what is the culmination of the spiritual path?’”

verses.pali: “Ayameva kho, āvuso, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo brahmacariyaṁ, seyyathidaṁ—
verses.english: “The spiritual path is simply this noble eightfold path, that is:
right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right immersion.

verses.pali: Yo kho, āvuso, rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo—
verses.english: The ending of greed, hate, and delusion:
this is the culmination of the spiritual path.”
